name: RAMS 60
description: Dieter Rams / Swiss 1960s hi-fi instrument design system. Ivory faceplate, one shellac-black rotating disc as sculptural contrast, Braun signal-green as sole functional accent with Braun orange for degradation/hot states, dense technical annotation (tick scales, index numbers, tabular readouts), architectural grotesque typography. Skeuomorphic turntable centerpiece with physically-correct tonearm, procedural aging render, and gesture-driven scratch interaction.

typography.fontFamilyHeadings: Neue Haas Grotesk, Helvetica Neue, Univers, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
typography.fontFamilyBody: Neue Haas Grotesk, Helvetica Neue, Univers, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

components.knobStyle: ivory-cap-rotary (radial highlight, dashed knurl ring, ink pointer, centered tick ring: ink 0-100%, green tick @100%, orange >100%)
components.selectorStyle: recessed-slot paddle switch (horizontal detents + vertical A/B side toggle)
components.meterStyle: tape-recorder level ruler (vertical or horizontal needle, green zone band, orange CLIP tick)
components.centerpieceStyle: canvas turntable: shellac disc, degree tick scale, constant-length cream tonearm on fixed pivot, procedural scratches/dust driven by AGE, drag-to-scratch gesture
components.footerStatusLadder: BYPASS · CLEAN SIGNAL / LIGHT DUSTING / TRACING / REFERENCE FINGERPRINT / WORN PRESSING / INNER-GROOVE COLLAPSE

motionRules.labelSpin: spindle label rotates with disc, index notch reads motion
motionRules.vuNeedle: gentle random walk aligned to printed scale
motionRules.armIntro: optional lift/swing/settle (~1.9s) — removed by user in v7, kept optional
